`tap-02-vectors.json` is the unmodified public vector file from TapeOutProtocol/TAPs commit `527477ecb7cf68ee9e86d8292669d57fe1680572`, `assets/tap-02/vectors.json` (CC0 specification).

emeter's compiler intentionally supports stateless NAND only. LATCH and REF cases are retained as reference data and are refused by this compiler; the independent official Python evaluator supports them.
